story:
The Brave Little Mango Tree

In a sunny village, there was a tiny mango tree named Mino. While other trees were tall and strong, Mino was small and often laughed at by the wind.

One day, a big storm came. The tall trees tried to stand strong—but many branches broke. Mino bent with the wind, swaying gently.

After the storm, Mino was still standing proudly.

A wise old bird said, “Strength isn’t about being stiff—it’s about knowing when to bend.”

Moral: Being flexible can make you stronger.
